Mia (Events): Quick check — new lightning-run webinar on Thu. Can we run a super-tight ops checklist?
Jordan (Producer): Yes. Minimal: reg page -> 2 time slots (NA/APAC friendly), Zoom -> cloud recording + local backup, auto-transcribe on, co-host added.
Sam (Growth): For reg page please include timezone selector and lead source hidden field, we'll route leads by utm_campaign.
Lina (DemandGen): I'll own the post-event nurture. Can we get recordings split into 3-5 min clips automatically?
Jordan (Producer): Plan: record full session to cloud; post-event we'll run quick clip churn (timestamps from slides). I'll add `zoom` cloud recording to S3 transfer.
Mia (Events): @Sam @Lina owners? Sam for lead routing, Lina for clips + nurture. I'll schedule the rehearsal Tue.
zoom-bot: Recording enabled for meeting 987-654-321, cloud + local. Auto-transcribe: ON.
Sam (Growth): Routing note: use `/zapier` hook tag `lightning-run-2026` so CRM mapping picks campaign and MQL flag. Also include `consent=true` checkbox on reg.
Jordan (Producer): Rehearsal checklist snippet: `1) mic check, 2) share slide deck, 3) record test clip, 4) check captions, 5) cohost handoff`. Can someone confirm captions work on our account?
Lina (DemandGen): Confirmed — captions enabled. After event: send clip + 24h replay email, plus gated full recording after 7 days. I'll prepare three CTAs for the nurture.
Mia (Events): Great. I'll post final ops runbook in #marketing tomorrow after rehearsal. :thumbsup:
Sam (Growth): I'll wire Zap and confirm lead routing by Wed EOD.
Jordan (Producer): I'll set the cloud -> S3 post-process and drop timestamps in a shared sheet.
Mia (Events): Perfect. Thanks team — short and decisive.
